snippet.title: Titan Quest II | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Embark on an epic odyssey when Titan Quest II arrives on PC, PlayStation 5, and XBOX Series X|S on January 19, 2027.

Wield legendary weapons, defy destiny, and challenge Nemesis, the Goddess of Retribution, in an action RPG inspired by Greek mythology.
